sources.says: CM Resolution No. 578 (13 Sep 2025), Appendix 1: cl. 9 a bachelor's applicant has finished an 11-year general secondary school, or a 9+2 secondary specialised or initial vocational school; cl. 10 the state test's registration runs 5-25 June every year; cl. 36 the tests are held in July-August; cl. 12 (amended 29 Jan 2026) a B2+ national or international language certificate gives the foreign-language subject's full points, B1 gives 75 %

Order No. 105 of the Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovation (13 Mar 2026), Annex 1: the state universities' bachelor test is 90 questions, 3 compulsory subjects (10 each, 1.1 points) and 2 subjects of the field (30 each, 3.1 and 2.1 points), at most 189.0 points

text.en: CAU's entrance exams, 50% to pass each: English (60 questions, 30 minutes) and maths, or chemistry and biology, depending on the programme (20 questions in 45 minutes each); 100,000 UZS a subject. A national certificate at C+, or SAT Math 585 for maths, exempts you

text.ru: Вступительные экзамены CAU, проходной балл 50% по каждому: английский (60 вопросов, 30 минут), а также, в зависимости от программы, математика или химия и биология (по 20 вопросов за 45 минут); 100 000 сумов за предмет. Национальный сертификат не ниже C+, а для математики SAT Math 585, освобождает от экзамена

sources.says: CAU's 'Admission Regulations' page: entrance exams in maths, chemistry and biology (20 questions, 45 minutes each) and English (60 questions, 30 minutes), 50 % to pass each; after passing English, a mandatory 10-minute interview with the Admissions Committee; exemption from the English exam with IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 60 or SAT English 585 (medicine, dentistry) or IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 46 or SAT English 585 (business, engineering, hospitality and tourism); from biology and chemistry with a national certificate at C+ (medicine, dentistry); from maths with SAT Math 585 or a national certificate at C+; 100,000 UZS a subject. It groups only the exemptions by faculty: it never says which faculty sits which subject exam, and its Architecture & Design School is not named there (so the exam text says 'depending on the programme'; a question for admission@centralasian.uz). Its scholarship exam date is for 2025-2026; its entrance exam section names no year (the 2026 news pages above confirm entrance exams and the language levels for 2026)

note.en: Its own table says IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72 or Cambridge B2 First for bachelor's, and also lists “MU exam: pass”, but its FAQ and how-to-apply page say IELTS is required for English-taught programmes: ask the admissions office which applies to your programme. Programmes taught in Uzbek list only the school certificate and the exam
note.uz: Uning jadvalida bakalavriat uchun IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72 yoki Cambridge B2 First, shuningdek “MU imtihoni: oʻtish” koʻrsatilgan, lekin FAQ va ariza topshirish sahifalarida ingliz tilida oʻqitiladigan dasturlarga IELTS talab qilinishi aytilgan: dasturingizga qaysi biri tegishli ekanini qabul boʻlimidan soʻrang. Oʻzbek tilidagi dasturlarda faqat maktab bitiruv hujjati va imtihon koʻrsatilgan
note.ru: В её же таблице для бакалавриата указаны IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72 или Cambridge B2 First, а также «Экзамен MU: зачёт», но в FAQ и на странице о подаче заявки сказано, что для программ на английском нужен IELTS: уточните в приёмной комиссии, что относится к вашей программе. Для программ на узбекском указаны только аттестат и экзамен

text.en: Millat Umidi's entrance exam, on campus every Wednesday (fee 300,000 UZS): English, maths and logic, and questions for your programme
text.uz: Millat Umidining kirish imtihoni, kampusda har chorshanba (toʻlov 300 000 soʻm): ingliz tili, matematika va mantiq hamda dasturingizga oid savollar
text.ru: Вступительный экзамен Millat Umidi, в кампусе каждую среду (сбор 300 000 сумов): английский, математика и логика, а также вопросы по вашей программе

sources.says: Millat Umidi's 'Entry requirements' page as a browser draws it (2026-10-04; a plain request answers 404, the page is drawn by the site's own script and its translations): per bachelor's programme a school certificate or equivalent, 'IELTS 5.0+ or equivalent' (Accounting and Finance, ACCA; Software Engineering, Certiport) or 'IELTS 5.5+' (English Language Teaching, CELTA), and a pass in the university's entrance exam; Uzbek-medium bachelor's: the certificate and the entrance exam; its English table: bachelor's IELTS 5.5+, TOEFL iBT 72+, Cambridge B2 First, 'MU exam: pass' (the only place the site names its own exam beside IELTS; its FAQ and how-to-apply page say IELTS is required for English-medium programmes, so the record asks IELTS and the note sends the student to the admissions office); admissions open (rolling), entrance exams every Wednesday, exam fee 300,000 UZS, classes begin 15 September; documents: passport or ID and school certificate (original and copy), 4 photos 3x4 cm, IELTS certificate (5.5 minimum for English programmes), transcript

the steps: choose a programme, apply online with the documents, the entrance exam on campus (fee 300,000 UZS), a personal interview with the admissions committee, the offer, enrolment; its entrance exam section: 'IELTS Exam' ('required for all English-medium programs'; in Uzbek 'barcha ingliz tilida oʻqitiladigan dasturlar uchun talab qilinadi') and a maths and logic exam

'Is IELTS required for admission?': IELTS is required for English-medium programmes, 5.0 for the Business and IT bachelor's programmes, 5.5 for ELT; the entrance exam covers English, logical reasoning and questions for the chosen programme; no strict GPA cutoff; rolling admission, exams every Wednesday

note.en: Either admits you to year 1 without the entrance exam (with IELTS, Economics, Marketing and Aviation Engineering still take a maths and logic exam); IELTS 5.0 from the last 12 months also lets you take the exam in Uzbek, except for Mechanical, Civil, Computer and Aviation Engineering
note.uz: Ularning har biri bilan 1-kursga imtihonsiz qabul qilinasiz (IELTS bilan Iqtisodiyot, Marketing va Aviatsiya muhandisligiga topshirganlar matematika va mantiqdan qoʻshimcha imtihon topshiradi); soʻnggi 12 oydagi IELTS 5.0 bilan imtihonni oʻzbek tilida ham topshirish mumkin (Mashina, Qurilish, Kompyuter va Aviatsiya muhandisligidan tashqari)
note.ru: Любой из них даёт приём на 1-й курс без вступительного экзамена (с IELTS на экономику, маркетинг и авиационную инженерию сдают дополнительный экзамен по математике и логике); с IELTS 5.0, полученным за последние 12 месяцев, экзамен можно сдать на узбекском (кроме машиностроения, строительной, компьютерной и авиационной инженерии)

limit.en: not for Economics, Marketing and Aviation Engineering, which still take a maths and logic exam
limit.uz: Iqtisodiyot, Marketing va Aviatsiya muhandisligi bundan mustasno: ularda matematika va mantiq imtihoni qoladi
limit.ru: кроме экономики, маркетинга и авиационной инженерии, где остаётся экзамен по математике и логике

text.en: TTPU's computer-based entrance exam: 30 maths and 10 logic questions in 90 minutes, in English; 30% admits you to year 1, 20% to the International Foundation Year; up to 3 attempts, registration 200,000 UZS

text.ru: Компьютерный вступительный экзамен TTPU: 30 вопросов по математике и 10 по логике за 90 минут, на английском; 30% дают приём на 1-й курс, 20% — на International Foundation Year; до 3 попыток, регистрация 200 000 сумов

sources.says: TTPU's 'Bachelor Programs - Admission Regulations 2026/2027' on its admissions portal (turin.uz links it as ADMISSION), read in English and Uzbek on 2026-10-04: register at qabul.turin.uz or in room 106 (fee 200,000 UZS), up to 3 attempts; a computer-based exam of 30 maths and 10 logic questions in 90 minutes, in English, or in Uzbek with an IELTS 5.0+ certificate issued within a year (not for Mechanical, Civil, Computer or Aviation Engineering); 30 % admits to year 1, 20 % to the International Foundation Year, below 20 % not admitted; IELTS 5.0 or SAT 1100 admits to year 1 without the exam (Economics, Marketing and Aviation Engineering applicants with IELTS take an extra maths and logic exam); originals: passport or ID with PINFL, birth certificate if under passport age, the 11-grade school certificate or a college or vocational diploma with its transcript; exam dates are announced at qabul.turin.uz

conditional_note.en: Below the full level (IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 69-79): conditional admission, with free English classes in the first two semesters.
conditional_note.uz: Toʻliq darajadan pastroq boʻlsa (IELTS 5.5 yoki TOEFL iBT 69-79): shartli qabul, birinchi ikki semestrda bepul ingliz tili darslari bilan.
conditional_note.ru: Ниже полного уровня (IELTS 5.5 или TOEFL iBT 69-79): условный приём с бесплатными занятиями английским в первые два семестра.

route_note.en: These are the requirements BMU's page lists for its bachelor's programme. Any one of these meets its school requirement: BMU's Foundation or an equivalent international foundation, a first year at a university, 12 years of schooling under an internationally recognised curriculum, or an equivalent such as the IB. Direct Entry to year 2 is listed separately.
route_note.uz: Bu BMU sahifasida bakalavriat uchun koʻrsatilgan talablar. Taʼlim talabiga ulardan biri yetarli: BMU Foundation yoki unga teng xalqaro foundation dasturi, universitetda birinchi kurs, xalqaro tan olingan dastur boʻyicha 12 yillik taʼlim yoki IB kabi teng hujjat. 2-kursga toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri qabul alohida koʻrsatilgan.
route_note.ru: Это требования, которые BMU указывает для бакалавриата. Для требования к образованию достаточно одного из них: Foundation BMU или равноценная международная подготовительная программа, первый курс университета, 12 лет обучения по международно признанной программе или равноценный документ, например IB. Прямой приём на 2-й курс указан отдельно.

text.en: Maths: GCSE Maths grade C/4 or an equivalent qualification, plus a pass in BMU's maths entrance exam or in its Foundation's Quantitative Methods I module, or an SAT Math score at BMU's threshold

text.ru: Математика: GCSE Maths на оценку C/4 или равноценный документ, а также сданный вступительный экзамен BMU по математике или модуль Quantitative Methods I программы Foundation, либо балл SAT Math не ниже порога BMU
